description: One node of the XML document being built: its attributes, its children, and whether it is printed at all.

attributes.name: Print
description: Whether to emit this element. A node can be built and then suppressed, so the tree does not have to be pruned.

attributes.name: Element
description: The element's own value, when it is a leaf.

attributes.name: List
description: The child elements (`XMLE_Type`), when it is not.
